card.name: Dosing frequency and interval words
card.fires_on: Words inside dose schedule phrases, mainly the number after "every" (8, 12 hours) and words like "once", "times", "every" that set how often a drug is given. Also fires on some quantity words such as "final volume".

modes.label: Interval number
modes.description: The number after "every" in an hours-based dosing interval.
modes.example: some patients may require 500 mg every <<8>> hours

modes.label: Frequency word
modes.description: Words like once, times or every in a schedule such as weekly or four times a day.
modes.example: 800 mg four<< times>> a day and start Metaxalone Tablets

modes.label: Volume or increment wording
modes.description: Words in preparation or delivery instructions such as final volume or dose increments.
modes.example: may use a final<< volume>> of 130 to 1

card.plain: It lights up on the words that say how often or in what amount a dose is given.
